errors.text_span: The horizontal axis, labeled with segment types in alphabetical order, displays ‘Context,’ ‘Generated Response,’ ‘Other,’ and ‘Standard.’ The vertical axis represents the percentage of attention
errors.evidence: The description fundamentally misinterprets the chart's structure. It describes a vertical bar chart where the x-axis has categories and the y-axis has percentages. The actual figure is a horizontal stacked bar chart where the y-axis has categories ('Ours', 'Standard') and the x-axis represents the percentage composition of each bar.

errors.text_span: ranging from 0% to 70%, with tick marks spaced at 10% intervals
errors.evidence: The chart does not have a visible numerical axis with this range or these tick marks. The description invents this information.

errors.text_span: The tallest bar, colored blue, represents ‘Our’ response, indicating approximately 60.6% attention allocated to the ‘Context’ segment. The second tallest bar, colored orange, represents ‘Yours’ response, exhibiting approximately 31.7% attention to the same segment. The shortest bar, colored green, represents ‘Standard’ response, with an approximate value of 23.6% allocated to the ‘Context’ segment. The bar labeled ‘Generated Response’ is colored orange and represents approximately 51.1% of attention to the ‘Generated Response’ segment. Finally, the bar labeled ‘Other’ is colored green and represents approximately 25.3% of attention to the ‘Other’ segment.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the segments of the two stacked bars as multiple individual, separate bars. The chart contains only two bars ('Ours' and 'Standard'), each composed of three colored segments.

errors.text_span: specifically focusing on 'Context,' 'Generated Response,' 'Other,' and 'Standard' response types.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly groups 'Standard' as a segment type alongside 'Context,' 'Generated Response,' and 'Other'. 'Standard' is one of the two main categories being compared, represented by an entire bar.
The label on the chart is 'Ours', not 'Yours'.

errors.text_span: The shortest bar, colored green, represents ‘Standard’ response, with an approximate value of 23.6% allocated to the ‘Context’ segment.
errors.evidence: This sentence contains multiple errors. The green segment represents 'Other', not 'Standard'. The value 23.6% belongs to the blue 'Context' segment of the 'Standard' bar, not a green segment/bar.
